claims.claim: Membrane state makes a temporal motion-direction label decodable where stateless propagation cannot.
claims.mechanism: LIF membrane potential v_t = decay*v_{t-1} + syn(spikes_{t-1}) + drive_t carries a decaying trace across frames; the stateless GNN recomputes each frame independently and is time-permutation-invariant at the readout.
claims.assumptions: Short 8-frame sequences, fixed 70/30 split, spectral-radius-normalised real FlyWire graph, real ommatidium sampling, Kenyon readout, homeostasis keeping synaptic current bounded; five independent seeds.
claims.falsifying_ablation: Remove state (stateless) or remove propagation (A=0); also the flash task that needs no cross-frame integration.
claims.split_protocol: Fixed 70/30 random split, identical across all conditions and seeds, ridge readout with L2=1e-2.
claims.primary_metric: Classification accuracy on the held-out 30% of the direction task; headline is the delta versus stateless.
claims.minimum: delta(lif_homeostasis - stateless) >= +0.15 with 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.
claims.expected_strong: delta(lif_combo - stateless) >= +0.25 with CI lower bound > 0, calibrated on the local +0.2817 result.
claims.failure: delta <= 0, CI lower bound <= 0, ceiling < 0.90, or NaN/missing raw results.
claims.simple_baseline: Frame-stacked pixel ridge ceiling and the stateless 3-step tanh(A@x) GNN baseline.
claims.strong_baseline: The published train-your-fly connectome GNN propagation used as our stateless baseline (official static 64.0% is literature context, not a rerun).
claims.matched_control: A=0 (no propagation), degree-preserving rewiring with matched nnz/weights/degree, and sign-shuffled E/I control.
claims.implementation_path: mining/common.py and run_v7_temporal.py locally; remote experiment.py generated by the novix agent and pulled back into novix/pulled before any verdict.
claims.prototype_check: Local light_smoke.py self-test passed: 7 variants, 19.2 s, 4.0 GB peak, graph load 2.7 s; local round7 measured +0.2817 with CI [0.2033, 0.3617].
claims.calibration_evidence: Local real measurements in mining/results/round5..8.json calibrate the target. runtime_hours and memory_gb here are feasibility ESTIMATES ONLY; per the user directive 2026-11-07 14:34 no wall-clock or turn cap is imposed on the novix exp-4090 task and no --timeout/--max-turns is passed to task create.
claims.test_isolation: The held-out split is frozen before tuning; all five seeds and every failed run are logged; a test used for method selection is never described as unseen.
claims.stop_return_condition: If the ceiling is below 0.90, a main condition is NaN/unavailable, or the pulled script and result.json are absent, stop before P2 and return to task design; never tune to significance.
